about: The look set of docs/spec/structured-routing.md (S0): boards every stage is reviewed on by eye, the designer's routing beside ours, per copper layer. A board is either a PCBench id (taken from two pcbench runs) or a pair of board files (paths from the lab directory, or absolute).

boards.title: pierre (Own-Mailbox)
boards.why: 4 layers, DDR3 bus, BGA; our inner layers run the same way

boards.title: CAL430FR
boards.why: 2 layers, QFP with buses the designer bundles by channel

boards.title: FMCW radar, MCU board
boards.why: mixed signal, MCU with pairs and a bus

boards.title: RGB matrix panel CPLD backpack
boards.why: a matrix connector fanned to a CPLD

boards.title: Shift-in 32 (HC165)
boards.why: repeated cells and parallel buses, no vias in the designer's

boards.title: ULPI Pmod
boards.why: one short fast bus between two parts

boards.title: 1Bitsy
boards.why: MCU breakout: a ring of pins out to two headers

boards.title: Synthetic bus board
boards.why: two buses on an empty board: the easy case
boards.ours_note: routed 2026-11-12 by the spike binary without --ribbons (main's code at ed4d369), not from the named run

boards.title: motionhexa (unified, addressable pixels)
boards.why: hexagonal board, 271 SK9822 pixels, hand-routed along the hexagon's own directions: the reference for sector frames
boards.ours_note: ours: one run from bare pads by main's binary (sqpad-9512c88), default recipe, seed 0, 120 CPU s; not from the named run. Designer's board: motionhexa origin/main at b205798.

not_yet: easy2350: its reference is a FreeRouting route, not a designer's; needs a route with the job's recipe
earring, round pendant: no hand-routed reference; to be shown ours-only once they route in one run
